description: Corrections de dissertation : accords, articles, faux amis, majuscules, vocabulaire actu

questions.question: Correct sentence?
choix: The UN have got a budget
questions.explication: UN = organisation singulière → has. En anglais britannique on tolère le pluriel pour un groupe de personnes (the team are), mais à l'écrit formel : has.

questions.question: Correct?
choix: The UN is face many challenges
questions.explication: 3e personne du singulier au présent simple : verbe + s.

questions.question: Correct?
choix: The NATO intervened in the conflict
questions.explication: Exception : NATO, UNESCO, NASA sont des acronymes prononcés comme des mots → PAS d'article. Mais on dit the UN, the US, the EU, the WHO (on épelle les lettres).

questions.question: Which ones need « the »?
questions.explication: On dit the UN, the US(A), the EU, the UK, the ICC. Mais NATO, UNICEF, UNESCO sans article.

questions.question: « In more of that » is wrong. The correct linking word is:
questions.explication: Moreover / Furthermore / What is more / In addition.

questions.question: Correct spelling of the country:
questions.explication: Ukraine, sans article en anglais (« in Ukraine »).

questions.question: Correct?
questions.explication: People = pluriel de person. « Peoples » = des peuples (nations). « Persons » ne s'emploie qu'en langage juridique.

questions.question: Correct reflexive pronoun:
questions.explication: myself, yourself, himself / ourselves, yourselves, themselves.

questions.question: Correct?
choix: The existence of the UN is debated
Existence of the UN is debated
An existence of the UN is debated
The existance of the UN is debated
questions.explication: Nom déterminé par « of the UN » → the. Et attention : existence, avec deux e.

questions.question: Correct spelling:
questions.explication: To negotiate, a negotiation, negotiations (souvent au pluriel).

questions.question: Correct sentence:
choix: To stop the threat from Russia
To stop the threat of Russia to attack
questions.explication: Threat = nom (menace) ; to threaten = verbe. On dit a threat from / a threat to someone.

questions.question: Correct?
questions.explication: Paire : On (the) one hand… On the other hand… Toujours au singulier.

questions.question: The noun corresponding to « to condemn » is:
questions.explication: To condemn (le n final ne se prononce pas) → condemnation.

questions.question: Correct?
questions.explication: Negotiations (pluriel) + were. To stall = s'enliser, être au point mort.

questions.question: « Rare earth » refers to:
choix: Rare earth elements / metals, used in tech
questions.explication: Terres rares. Souvent « rare earths » ou « rare earth elements (REE) ». Ex. : China dominates rare earth production.

questions.question: « AI » stands for:
questions.explication: On écrit AI, ou artificial intelligence en toutes lettres à la première mention.

questions.question: Correct expression:
questions.explication: He is well known for his speeches. Participe passé irrégulier : know / knew / known.

questions.question: Correct capitalization:
questions.explication: Le titre prend une majuscule quand il précède le nom, et sans article.

questions.question: Correct?
choix: The President said…(without a name, generic)
questions.explication: Sans nom propre, le titre est un nom commun : the president, the king, the prime minister, the secretary-general.

questions.question: Correct form for the British monarch:
questions.explication: On écrit King Charles III et on prononce « King Charles the Third ».

questions.question: Correct?
questions.explication: To come / to go TO a place. « Come in » = entrer dans une pièce.

questions.question: « To reach an agreement » means:
questions.explication: Synonymes : to strike a deal, to come to an agreement.

questions.question: « To take action against… » means:
questions.explication: Attention : action est indénombrable ici, pas de « an action ». Ex. : The Council failed to take action against the regime.

questions.question: Correct?
choix: The UN try to resolve conflicts
The UN tries to resolve conflicts
questions.explication: Même règle que has / faces.

questions.question: Typical mistakes in a « dissertation »: which sentences are correct?
choix: Moreover, the UN faces a crisis
In more of that, the UN face a crisis
On the other hand, negotiations were stalled
We can ask ourselves whether the UN is useful

questions.question: « To threaten » + what?
questions.explication: To threaten to do sth / to threaten sb with sth.

questions.question: Correct plural agreement:
choix: The US is a permanent member
The US are a permanent member
The US be a permanent member
questions.explication: The US / the USA = un pays, donc singulier.
